BiblicalUsage: Jushab-hesed is named once, in 1 Chronicles 3:20. In 1 Chronicles 3:20 we read, "And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed, five."
TheologicalSignificance: Jushab-hesed is a name the Bible did not forget, and I believe God forgets no one.
